name: claude-cockpit
description: Launch Claude Code from VS Code, with traffic-light terminal tab titles and notifications when Claude needs you.

claudeCockpit.command.description: Command used to launch Claude Code.

claudeCockpit.notifyOnBlocked.description: Show a notification when Claude is blocked waiting for your input.

claudeCockpit.notifyOnDone.description: Show a notification when Claude finishes responding.

claudeCockpit.statusBarButton.description: Show the ✳ cc launch button in the status bar.

claudeCockpit.playSounds.description: Play sounds on Claude state changes (blocked/done).

claudeCockpit.soundBlocked.description: Sound when Claude is blocked waiting for your input: a macOS system sound name (from /System/Library/Sounds) or a path to an audio file (required on Linux). Empty disables.

claudeCockpit.soundDone.description: Sound when Claude finishes responding: a macOS system sound name or a path to an audio file (required on Linux). Empty disables.
